item.title: New Linux Kernel Flaw Gives ARM64 KVM Guests Read-Write Access to Host Memory
item.description: A new flaw in the Linux kernel's KVM virtualization code for ARM64 processors can leave a freed piece of host memory exposed to a guest virtual machine on hosts with nested virtualization enabled. The bug, tracked as CVE-2026-89775, allows a guest to read and write host kernel memory, and the researcher who found it says it can be used to escape the guest and run code on the host machine.
item.dc:creator: The Hacker News

item.title: WordPress Comment2Shell Flaw Can Turn Anonymous Comment XSS Into RCE via Admin Session
item.description: A new flaw in WordPress core let an anonymous visitor leave a comment that planted a hidden script on the page. If a logged-in administrator later opened that page, the script could run code on the site's server.
